name: barrier_r3_L06
trained_on: MolmoAct2-LIBERO (allenai/MolmoAct2-LIBERO-LeRobot), LIBERO sim, two cameras (agentview + wrist), two cubes (red/green); on-policy velocity matching to the same frozen policy prompted "pick up the red cube"; students "pick up the cube" and "pick up the green cube". Not fitted on MolmoAct2-SO100_101 and may not transfer.
alpha_unit: module scale: median L2 norm of text-token activations at this layer (fit set)

bank.how: mean block-6 output of the 5 tokens ' pick up the red cube' under the teacher prompt, over the 5,318 round-0 observations (steervla runs/steering_dial/data/bank.npy); frozen, independent of the observation

results: steervla runs/steering_dial/results.md (LIBERO test, fresh layouts): hard red 79% neutral prompt, 77% under the green prompt; barrier = constant vector in every setting; zero-edit fraction 0% (never switches off), mean edit norm 28.5 neutral, 41.7 green
k_note: k scales the edit (ControlLLM form): u = k * ReLU(tau - <a,h>) a; k=0 no edit, k=1 trained. steervla steering_wrist's sim sweep scaled the threshold instead, so its k values do not carry over.
